about: D1 attribution evidence: local, non-model evidence on which credential source the pinned codex-cli 0.160.0 uses. No model call, no token text, no secret read; credential manager entries are recorded by target name shape only.

evidence.reading: the frozen exec route with an empty worker home: 401 Unauthorized, Missing bearer or basic authentication in header, on the WebSocket and the HTTPS transport
request boundary capture of the frozen route with an empty worker home: 8 requests, none with an authorization header (bearer_source ['None'])

empty_home.expected: no credential: the route sends no bearer and the server answers 401 (no hidden fallback to the owner's credential)

exec_route_differential.reading: the empty home shows there is no hidden fallback credential; the scrambled versus valid contrast, with the bearer captured at the request boundary equal to the prepared file token, shows the credential the route uses is the worker auth.json

evidence.reading: request boundary capture of the frozen route with an auth.json holding the baseline account metadata and scrambled tokens (Isolation.prepare(scrambled=True)): every one of the 15 requests carried the bearer of the prepared auth.json (bearer_source ['prepared_access_token']); no baseline or other token was sent; no request left the loopback interface

evidence.enforced_by: isolation.telemetry_certificate (exec_probe outcome auth_failure, no reply, no usage, worker home, account metadata kept) before the charged telemetry call

scrambled_file_with_baseline_account_met.expected: the route sends exactly the tokens of the prepared auth.json, so a server rejects them and the call ends in an authentication failure without reply or usage

evidence.enforced_by: isolation.telemetry_certificate (call outcome ok, plain stream, auth_source store file at a prepared worker home with its auth_sha256)

valid_file.expected: the prepared baseline auth.json authenticates the call

executable.note: isolation.executable_identity of the codex launcher on PATH resolves to this native package binary

not_established: a complete credential access trace (Process Monitor) of the authenticated execution route: not recorded and, under owner decision 4, not required

os_credential_store.key_derivation: the 16 hex characters equal the first 16 of sha256 over the UTF-8 extended length path \\?\<owner home>\.codex
os_credential_store.method: cmdkey /list (target names only; no secret read), Windows Credential Manager of the owner
os_credential_store.reading: the only Codex entry in the OS credential store is keyed by a hash of the owner CODEX_HOME path (~/.codex), not by account data; no entry exists for the baseline path or any worker path. It belongs to secret_auth_storage, which the frozen route disables (--disable secret_auth_storage)

route_binding: the frozen argv carries -c cli_auth_credentials_store="file" and --disable secret_auth_storage (config.ROUTE_SECURITY_ARGS, config.DISABLE_FEATURES), enforced by isolation.argv_check and verify_launch

the telemetry certificate adds the scrambled token exec probe at a worker path (account metadata of the baseline kept, tokens no server accepts): an account indexed credential store would authenticate it; an authentication failure without reply or usage excludes that counterexample on the actual route

static_strings.keyring_service: the string Codex Auth sits next to the error text failed to delete auth from keyring: the OS keyring service name of the keyring store
static_strings.method: grep -a -o -F counts over the pinned codex.exe

status_basis: owner decision 4 (owner-decisions.md, A4.14.3): the exec route differential is accepted as complete attribution evidence; the D1 ruling text is amended accordingly (D1-auth-attribution.md, Owner amendment). A Process Monitor trace is not required.

store_selection_black_box.method: codex login status in fresh empty CODEX_HOME copies at a harness worker path (Isolation.empty_home, isolation.child_env, run.run_local), one fresh home per command
store_selection_black_box.reading: the configuration knob accepts exactly file, keyring, auto and ephemeral (a bogus value is refused); with no auth.json at the worker path no store, the OS keyring included, yields a credential for that path
